Traffic Light
Child I draw three circles. One, two, three.
Child I see circles: red, yellow, green.
Red I have red. Red says stop.
Yellow I have yellow. Yellow says slow.
Green I have green. Green says go.
Child One black box. I have black.
Child This is a traffic light. Go, crayons, go! Vroom!
💡 Remember
  • red = stop · yellow = slow · green = go

The Park
This is a tree. It's big. It's green and brown.
This is the sun. It's a circle. It's yellow.

💬 Speaking Tip
  • Say the shape, then the color: “It's a circle. It's yellow.”
